content.text: The backend has a separate endpoint for new emails, and the frontend has a matching page, `/confirm-new-email`. The mail URL should point there.

candidates.explanation: The verification link for a changed email is built with the '/confirm-email' path, which is the same page as the sign-up activation link in userSignUp. That page calls POST auth/email/confirm (AuthService.confirmEmail), which expects a JWT with only confirmEmailUserId and sets the user's status to active. It never applies newEmail. The change is only applied by auth/email/confirm/new (AuthService.confirmNewEmail), which the frontend reaches from '/confirm-new-email'. So following the mail link never completes the email change.

fix.description: In MailService.confirmNewEmail, build the URL with the '/confirm-new-email' path instead of '/confirm-email'.
